Name: Fill Your Basket - Bulk Shopping and Saved Lists
Author: okklik
Description:
[b]一篮买齐 · 批量购物与常购清单[/b]
春天去皮埃尔的杂货店，土豆种子想买 24 包？点货架上的「数量」，填 24，再点「确定」。花椰菜只要一包，点它旁边的「+1」。挑好后点右边的「核对购物篮」，看过总价再付款。

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56022/56022-1795699601-1384454362.png[/img]

• [b]把这单存成「春播」[/b]  付款前打开「常购清单」，把这一篮存下来。下次照原数量买，或点「只补缺的」。土豆种子要 24 包，家里还剩 8 包？这次加 16 包就够了。

• [b]买多了，带回原店[/b]  六家店都认自己的小票。木材买多了，开票当天或次日带回罗宾那儿，点背包里的木材就能按买入价退一件，也可以改数量。可退商品看小票。想卖农产品，照常按店家收购价卖。

• [b]柜台边的闲话[/b]  从威利那儿买碗鳟鱼汤，他有时会说「先喝口热汤再下竿。鱼等得起。」每天第一次从店主手里买普通商品，左侧就会出现一句对白。你可以边看边挑下一样。

• [b]买之前，先看看哪天能收[/b]  在皮埃尔的杂货店，把鼠标停在蓝莓种子上，看小田里的嫩芽长出果子。点小田换个播种日，就知道头一茬哪天熟，这一季还能摘几回。

• [b]用电话问货，送到农场[/b]  在电话里点商品图标，看哪家有货、卖多少钱。向营业中的店下单，每单运费 50 金，约半个游戏小时送到农舍门口，也可以指定一个箱子收货。

• [b]顺路去趟酒吧或铁匠铺[/b]  带个蛋到酒吧，花 30 金请格斯煎蛋。浇水壶在克林特那儿升级时，也可以花 100 金借把备用的。

适用于单人游戏，内含简体中文和英文。安装 SMAPI 后，把压缩包里的 ShoppingBasket 文件夹放进游戏的 Mods 文件夹，再用 SMAPI 启动游戏。

[b]Fill Your Basket - Bulk Shopping and Saved Lists[/b]
Shopping for 24 packets of potato seeds at Pierre’s General Store? Click Qty on the shelf, enter 24, then choose Done. Want one packet of cauliflower seeds too? Click +1 beside it. When you’re ready, choose Review basket on the right, check the total, and select Pay.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56022/56022-1795699616-989952227.png[/img]

• [b]Save it as Spring Planting[/b]  Open Saved lists before you pay and give the basket a name. Next time, add the same quantities or choose Add what's missing. If your list calls for 24 potato seeds and you have 8 left in a farm chest, you only need 16 more.

• [b]Bring the extras back[/b]  All six shops take returns on eligible purchases. Bought too much wood? Bring it back to Robin on the receipt date or the next day. Click the stack in your pack to return one at the price you paid, or choose a quantity. You can also sell produce at the shop’s usual rate.

• [b]A word from the shopkeeper[/b]  Buy a bowl of trout soup from Willy and he might tell you, “Have a bit of hot soup before ye cast a line. The fish can wait.” Each shopkeeper has a line for your first purchase of ordinary goods at their counter each day. The text stays on the left while you browse.

• [b]See what will ripen in time[/b]  Hover over Blueberry Seeds at Pierre’s General Store and watch the trial plot grow from sprouts to ripe berries. Click the plot to try a planting date and see when the first harvest falls and how many more you can fit in.

• [b]Call the shops from your farm[/b]  Pick an item from the phone catalogue to see who stocks it and what they charge. Order while the shop is open. For 50g per order, your parcel arrives at your farmhouse door or a chest you choose in about 30 in-game minutes.

• [b]While you're in town[/b]  Bring an egg to the saloon and Gus will fry it for 30g. If Clint is upgrading your watering can, you can rent a spare for 100g.

For single-player, in English and Simplified Chinese. Install SMAPI, extract the ShoppingBasket folder into your game's Mods folder, and launch through SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Shopping Basket
Manifest.Description: Choose how many of each item to buy, check out in one go, and save your usual shopping list. You can also preview crops at the counter or order supplies by phone.
